summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. 33/33 new pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_cafe_iter2.py covering: per-item discount math (incl. negative-line clamp), payment_mode default/capture/filter (Cash/Card/UPI/Other), date-range filter with inclusive to_date + 400 on invalid to_date, CSV export (route ordering BEFORE /bills/{id}, content-type text/csv, attachment header, exact header row, payment_mode filter, auth required, invalid to_date 400), Users CRUD by admin (list, create with role validation, duplicate-email 400, delete, self-delete blocked with 400), full cashier RBAC (403 on menu POST/PUT/DELETE, settings PUT, users GET/POST/DELETE; 200 on bills POST; public GETs still work), and backward compatibility (default Cash payment_mode and 0 item discount). Iteration-1 regression: 23/23 still passing.

minor.issue: from_date is not validated for ISO format (only to_date is). A malformed from_date is silently treated as a string prefix, which could lead to confusing zero-result queries. Consider validating both for symmetry.
No password strength/length validation. Empty or 1-char passwords are accepted.
tax_percent/service_percent/discount_amount and item.discount accept negative values (no Pydantic Field(ge=0) guard). Already noted in iteration-1.
Date filter uses string-prefix comparison on ISO created_at; works because all created_at are stored as UTC ISO strings, but timezone-aware boundary edge cases exist for non-UTC clients.

critical_code_review_comments: Route order correctness: /api/bills/export is correctly declared BEFORE /api/bills/{bill_id} in server.py (lines 496 vs 552). Verified via test (export returns 200 text/csv, not 400 invalid id).
require_admin guard is consistently applied to /menu POST/PUT/DELETE, /settings PUT, and all /users endpoints — RBAC tests confirm 403 for cashier on every protected route.
_calc_totals correctly clamps per-line subtotal at 0 when discount exceeds price*qty (max(0.0, ...)), preventing negative subtotal contributions.
BillItemIn.discount defaults to 0.0 and BillIn.payment_mode defaults to 'Cash' — backward compat verified via API (legacy-shaped payloads work).
Admin self-delete is blocked with 400 in delete_user (str(oid) == admin['id']).
Minor: User creation does not log who created the user or audit role grants — acceptable for MVP.
Minor: CSV export reads up to 10,000 bills in memory; fine for current scale but should paginate/stream for production.
Minor: from_date format is not validated (only to_date is). Inconsistent and could mislead users; add the same try/except ValueError -> 400.
